description:
Hello, 
 Hope you are doing well. 
 
 
 Job Title:Essbase (Hyperion) Developer 
 
 Position Type: Contract to Hire 
 Location:PLANO, TX 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 Analyzing Requirements and translating requirements into Technical specs for Design and Development of Essbase Cubes in ASO Model ( 75%) and BSO Model (25%)

 Hands on Development of backend data marts  Oracle PL-SQL Programming for building Essbase Hierarchy Views/ Fact Views 

 Hand on Development of Smart View Reports / Custom Took Bar Maintenance ( using VB Scripting)

 Maintaining Hyperion Planning Applications - Changes to Web forms, User Security, Business Rules Modification and Hierarchy updates and Data Loads.

 Hand On Development and Maintenance of Autosys Scheduler Jobs for Essbase Cube builds

 Learn existing Essbase Footprint to develop into SME for future Development activities.

 Comprehensive experience in creation of Essbase applications, Essbase cubes including Analytic outlines, dimension build rules, data load rules, Workflows, user security, Calculation Scripts and Reports

 Expertise in developing Essbase applications involving BSO/ASO, Essbase Studio, Smart View, Administrative Services, LCM.

 Skilled in administering, automation, optimization and performance tuning of Essbase application data/metadata processing, upgrading, testing and migrating of cubes in different environments.

 Strong with Hyperion versions 11.x

 Strong with Oracle Database ( All Metadata and Data sourced from Oracle Database )

 Auto Sys Scheduling tool & Unix / Shell Scripting

 

 Required Skills 
 Must have 5 to 7 years of Experience in Essbase Cubes development,

 Experience with the following technologies ASO Model Cube Design/ Development. Performance Tuning ASO Model Cube

 Experience with at least 2 end to end Hyperion planning Implementations

 Experience with Web forms, Task Lists, Business Rules , Shared Services Security Provisioning

 Building Essbase Cubes using Essbase Studio and Data Mart framework Experience in  MAXL, MDX, Smart View, Essbase Toolbar Customization using VB Scripting

 Understanding the customization process for SmartView and having the ability to create custom reports and workflows

 High Proficiency with Oracle PLSQL programing

 Must have Unix shell scripting experience
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
